title: RRB Section Controller Provisional Answer Key 2026 (CEN 03/2026)
description: Final Answer Key — RRB has released the provisional answer key, question paper and recorded response sheet for the Section Controller CBT conducted on 12 and 13 October 2026. Candidates can log in through their respective regional RRB websites to check their responses. Objections can be submitted against questions, answer options and provisional answers by 03 November 2026 (5:00 PM). The objection fee is ₹50 per question plus applicable bank charges. The fee will be refunded if the objection is found correct, after deduction of bank charges.

title: RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT 2 Result 2026 (CEN 07/2025)
description: RRB NTPC UG CBT 2 Result 2026 has been declared on 30 October 2026. Candidates can download the region-wise merit list PDF, check individual scorecards and cutoff marks. Shortlisted candidates will proceed to the next stage, including the Computer-Based Typing Skill Test (CBTST), wherever applicable.
organization: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways, Government of India

description: Final Answer Key

PSSSB Clerk (Common Cadre) Provisional Answer Key 2026
description:
Final Answer Key — The Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board (PSSSB) released the Provisional Answer Key 2026 for the Clerk (Common Cadre) written examination held on 11 October 2026 under Advertisement No. 02/2026 for 531 vacancies. The answer keys are available for question paper Sets A, B, C and D.

Candidates could submit online objections from 13 October to 15 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM, through the official objection upload form. The original hard copy of the grievance form (Annexure-I) along with supporting documentary evidence must reach the PSSSB office by 20 October 2026. The objection fee, if any, is not specified in the provided source. Check the official website for the answer key notice and further updates.

title: TNPSC Group 2 Mains Answer Key 2026
description: Final Answer Key — Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) released the Mains Answer Key 2026 for the Combined Civil Services Examination-II (Group II and IIA Services) on 15 October 2026. The mains examination was held on 8 February 2026, and the mains result was declared on 29 June 2026. Candidates can visit the official TNPSC website and check the Answer Keys or Press Releases section to access the answer key PDF. Login with One Time Registration (OTR) credentials may be required. The official objection submission link, deadline and fee have not been confirmed in the provided source. Candidates should check the official website for updates.

title: JKSSB Junior Laboratory Technician Provisional Answer Key 2026
description:
Final Answer Key — Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has released the Provisional Answer Key 2026 for the Junior Laboratory Technician OMR-based written examination held on 14 October 2026 under Advertisement Notification No. 07 of 2025, Item Nos. 89–96. The answer key covers Question Paper Series A, B, C and D, with answers to Questions 1–120.

Candidates can submit objections offline within three working days starting from 15 October 2026, between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM. Objections must be submitted using the prescribed Annexure B form with supporting documentary evidence and a demand draft of ₹200 per question, payable to the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board. The fee is refundable if the objection is found genuine and correct. Late or online objections will not be accepted.
organization: Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) – Health and Medical Education Department

title: DSSSB Various Posts Final Answer Key 2026
description: Final Answer Key — DSSSB has issued the notice for displaying final answer keys for nine computer-based examinations covering MTS, Meter and Relay Tester Grade II, Junior Radiographer, Assistant Manager Public Relation, Legal Assistant, Assistant Manager General, Assistant Engineer Civil, Sub Editor Part A Tier II, and Assistant Editor Part A Tier II. The final answer key link is available from 15 October to 19 October 2026. Candidates should log in or access the relevant link on the official DSSSB website and select the correct post code. The answer keys are final; no objections or further correspondence will be entertained.
organization: Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB), Government of NCT of Delhi

title: RPSC Inspector of Factories Model Answer Key 2026
description: Final Answer Key — RPSC released the Model Answer Keys on 13 October 2026 for the Inspector of Factories (Chemical) Competitive Examination 2025 and the Inspector of Factories and Boilers Competitive Examination 2025. Separate PDF answer keys are available for both examinations. Candidates should download the relevant answer key from the official website and compare their responses. Objection dates, submission procedure, and fees have not been specified in the provided information.

title: Kerala PSC Village Field Assistant Final Answer Key 2026
description: Final Answer Key — Kerala PSC has released the Final Answer Key for the Village Field Assistant examination under Category No. 571/2025. The OMR examination was conducted on 19 September 2026. Final answer keys are available for Malayalam (85-26 M), Tamil (85-26 T), and Kannada (85-26 K). Candidates should select the correct medium and match their question booklet code (A, B, C, or D). Complaints against the final answer key will not be entertained.
organization: Kerala Public Service Commission (Kerala PSC) – Revenue Department

title: Tripura PSC Junior Engineer Final Answer Key 2026
description: Final Answer Key — Tripura Public Service Commission has released the Final Answer Key for the Junior Engineer Grade-I and Grade-II (Civil Engineering) Main Examination under Advertisement No. 08/2025. The answer keys cover General Studies, Paper-I and Paper-II for question paper Series A, B, C and D. Candidates can download the relevant answer key from the official TPSC website.

title: TG SET Response Sheet & Answer Key 2026
description: Final Answer Key — Osmania University has released the TG SET 2026 provisional answer key and candidate response sheets for the examination held on 28, 29 and 30 September 2026. Candidates can log in using their Hall Ticket Number and Date of Birth to download their response sheets and answer key. The objection window was open from 12 October 2026 (3:00 PM) to 15 October 2026 (11:00 PM), with a fee of ₹200 per question.

title: JKSSB MPHW Answer Key 2026
description: Final Answer Key — JKSSB has released the provisional answer key for the Female MPHW / Male Multipurpose Health Worker written examination held on 11 October 2026. The answer key covers question paper series A, B, C and D. Candidates can submit offline objections with supporting documents and a demand draft of ₹200 per question within the prescribed period. Check the official notification for complete instructions.
organization: Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) – Health and Medical Education Department

Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026–27
amount: ₹1.5 lakh per year until completion of the professional degree. The amount can support tuition, hostel, internet, transport, laptop, books, and stationery expenses.
description: Financial support for meritorious girl students from lower-income families pursuing the first year of a professional graduation course in academic year 2026–27.
eligibility:
Girl students across India who:
- Scored at least 75% or equivalent CGPA in Class 12.
- Have annual family income of ₹6 lakh or less.
- Have secured admission to the first year of a professional degree in 2026–27 at a reputed NIRF/NAAC-accredited institution.
- Are not children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation, or Buddy4Study.
organization: Kotak Mahindra Group, implemented in partnership with Kotak Education Foundation

title: SSC Constable GD in CAPFs, NIA, SSF and Rifleman GD in Assam Rifles Examination 2027
description: Computer-based examination covering General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics and English/Hindi. The usual scheme is 80 questions, 160 marks and 60 minutes. PET/PST, medical examination and document verification are additional selection stages. Confirm the scheme against the 2027 notification.

title: SSC Sub-Inspector (SI) in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination 2026
description: Paper 1: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Comprehension — 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Paper 2 tests English Language & Comprehension. Physical Standard Test, Physical Endurance Test and medical/document verification stages apply as notified.

title: SSC Multi-Tasking (Non-Technical) Staff & Havaldar Examination 2026
description: Session I: Numerical and Mathematical Ability, Reasoning Ability & Problem Solving. Session II: General Awareness and English Language & Comprehension. Session I has 40 questions; Session II has 50 questions. Each session is generally 45 minutes. Havaldar selection also includes PET/PST. Negative marking applies in Session II under the published pattern.

title: SSC Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination (CHSL) 2026
description: Tier 1: English Language, General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude and General Awareness. Tier 2 includes Mathematical Abilities, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge and the applicable typing/skill test.

title: SSC Junior Engineer Examination 2026
description: Paper 1 includes General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness aur General Engineering (Civil, Mechanical ya Electrical). Paper 2 primarily tests the candidate’s engineering discipline. Detailed topic distribution is given in the official notification.

title: SSC Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026
description: Tier 1: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude aur English Comprehension. Iske baad Tier 2 mein Mathematical Abilities, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge aur Data Entry Speed Test jaise components hote hain. Kuch posts ke liye Statistics ka additional paper hota hai.
organization: Staff Selection Commission, Government of India

title: RRB Junior Engineer / DMS / CMA, CEN 05/2025
description: CBT 1: Mathematics (30), Reasoning (25), General Awareness (15), General Science (30) — total 100 questions, 100 marks. CBT 2 includes technical engineering subjects, General Awareness, Physics/Chemistry, Computer Applications and Environment/Pollution Control. Engineering syllabus varies by discipline: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and other notified technical groups.

title: RRB Technician, CEN 02/2025
description: Technician Grade I Signal mein General Awareness, Reasoning, Basic Computers, Mathematics aur Basic Science & Engineering. Technician Grade III mein Mathematics, Reasoning, General Awareness aur General Science par focus hota hai; trade/post requirements notification ke mutabik check karein. CBT generally 100 questions, 90 minutes, with 1/3 negative marking.

title: RRB NTPC Graduate — CEN 06/2025; NTPC Undergraduate — CEN 07/2025
description: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, Current Affairs, General Science aur General Knowledge. CBT 1: 100 questions, 90 minutes. CBT 2: 120 questions, 90 minutes. Generally 1/3 negative marking; typing skill test ya CBAT post ke hisaab se applicable hai.
organization: Railway Recruitment Boards, Ministry of Railways

title: RRB Group D / Level-1, CEN 09/2025
description: CBT: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Science aur General Awareness/Current Affairs. Selection mein Physical Efficiency Test, document verification aur medical examination bhi applicable ho sakte hain. CBT pattern: 100 questions, 90 minutes; wrong answer ke liye 1/3 negative marking.
organization: Railway Recruitment Boards, Ministry of Railways

title: RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP), CEN 01/2026
description: CBT 1: Mathematics, Mental Ability/Reasoning, General Science aur General Awareness/Current Affairs. CBT 2 mein Mathematics, Reasoning, Basic Science & Engineering aur trade-specific qualifying test hota hai. Aage CBAT aur document verification applicable hote hain.
organization: Railway Recruitment Boards, Ministry of Railways

title: MPSC Group C Combined Preliminary Examination 2026 — including Talathi recruitment
description: Preliminary exam: 100 questions for 100 marks, OMR-based. Wrong answers attract a penalty of one-fourth of the marks for that question. Subjects include modern Indian history, with emphasis on Maharashtra; geography; Indian and government economy; current affairs; polity; general science; arithmetic; and reasoning/intelligence test. The exam is followed by the main examination for qualifying candidates.
organization: Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC), Government of Maharashtra

title: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship
amount: Assistance towards tuition fees and study materials, with additional accommodation support for eligible hostel students. The exact monetary amount depends on the eligibility category and is not specified in the current official FAQ.
description: Financial assistance for eligible students studying in Class XI, Class XII, ITI, Diploma, Graduation and Post-Graduation, including general, medical and engineering fields.
eligibility: Students up to 30 years of age. Annual family-income limit: ₹4 lakh for salaried employees and ₹2.5 lakh for other applicants, according to the published criteria. Final-year students are not eligible. Eligible students must satisfy the foundation’s academic and institution requirements.

title: Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships 2026–27
amount: Up to ₹6 lakh over the duration of the postgraduate programme.
description: Merit-based support for first-year postgraduate students in selected future-ready disciplines, with mentorship, industry exposure and professional development opportunities.
eligibility: Indian citizens enrolled in the first year of a full-time postgraduate degree in a listed field, including computer science, artificial intelligence, mathematics and computing, electrical/electronics engineering, mechanical or chemical engineering, renewable and new energy, materials science and engineering, or life sciences. Applicants must have a GATE score between 550 and 1,000 or an undergraduate CGPA of at least 7.5 (or equivalent percentage).

title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships 2026–27
amount: Up to ₹2 lakh over the duration of the undergraduate programme.
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship supporting students in their first year of an undergraduate degree in any stream, with additional mentoring and development opportunities.
eligibility: Indian citizens who passed Class XII with at least 60% marks and are enrolled in the first year of a regular, full-time undergraduate degree in academic year 2026–27. Household income must be below ₹15 lakh. The online aptitude test is mandatory.

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) 2026–27
amount: ₹12,000 per year, paid through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), subject to renewal and scheme requirements.
description: Scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker families to encourage them to continue their school education from Class IX through Class XII.
eligibility: Generally, students selected through the State/UT selection examination for the fresh Class IX award. The guidelines require at least 55% marks or equivalent in Class VII, with a 5-percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST students, and parental income not exceeding ₹3.5 lakh per year. Students must attend eligible government, government-aided or local-body schools.
organization: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India

title: Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education for SC Students
amount: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges, capped at ₹2 lakh per year for private-sector institutions; academic allowance of ₹86,000 in the first year and ₹41,000 in each subsequent year under the published guidelines.
description: Financial support for SC students pursuing higher education in eligible institutions notified under the scheme.
eligibility: SC students with annual family income up to ₹8 lakh, admitted to a full-time eligible course at a notified institution. Fresh awards are for first-year students and depend on available institutional slots and merit.
organization: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India

title: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
amount: Tuition fee and non-refundable charges, capped at ₹2 lakh per year for private-sector institutions; eligible commercial pilot training has a separate ceiling of ₹3.72 lakh per year. Additional benefits include ₹3,000 per month for living expenses, ₹5,000 per year for books and stationery, and up to ₹45,000 one-time assistance for a computer/laptop and accessories.
description: Financial support for eligible students from OBC, EBC and DNT communities pursuing higher education in institutions notified under the scheme.
eligibility: OBC, EBC or DNT students with annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh, admitted to a full-time eligible course at a notified institution. Selection is subject to the institution’s available scholarship slots and merit criteria.
organization: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India

title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme — Technical Degree/Diploma
amount: ₹50,000 per year towards eligible educational expenses, subject to the scheme rules and remaining course duration.
description: Financial support for eligible technical students facing specific family circumstances, including orphanhood and certain bereavement or serious parental health situations.
eligibility: Students in AICTE-approved regular degree/diploma courses who meet one of the prescribed conditions: orphaned; either or both parents died due to COVID-19; ward of Armed Forces or Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred in action; or a parent has a critical life-threatening disease or died or became severely disabled in an accident, as defined in the guidelines. Annual family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh. Students receiving a Central Government, State Government or AICTE-sponsored scholarship are excluded under the published rules.

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme — Technical Degree/Diploma
amount: ₹50,000 per year, subject to scheme rules and eligible course duration.
description: Financial assistance for specially-abled students pursuing eligible technical courses.
eligibility: Generally, students with a disability of at least 40%, admitted to the first year of an eligible AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma course or to the second year through lateral entry. Annual family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students — Technical Degree/Diploma
amount: ₹50,000 per year, subject to scheme rules and course duration.
description: Financial assistance to support girls pursuing technical education in AICTE-approved institutions.
eligibility: Girl students admitted to the first year of an eligible AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma course, or second year through lateral entry. Maximum two eligible girls per family; annual family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh.
organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Government of India

title: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies 2026–27
amount: ₹15,000 per month for 10 months each year, for two years — up to ₹3,00,000 over the two-year programme, subject to the scheme's conditions.
description: Merit-based financial assistance for students starting their first postgraduate degree at eligible institutions in India.
eligibility: Students admitted to the first year of their first recognised PG degree, generally below 30 years of age at admission, studying full-time at an eligible institution. Distance and part-time courses are excluded. Selection is based on all-India merit, with the scheme’s specified provisions for women and single/twin/fraternal girl children.
organization: University Grants Commission (UGC), Government of India

title: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers — Post-Matric Scholarship
amount: Class XI–XII: ₹3,000 per year; ITI, Polytechnic and general degree courses: ₹6,000 per year; eligible professional courses such as engineering and medicine: up to ₹25,000 per year.
description: Financial support for eligible children of workers in the beedi, cinema, specified mining and related covered worker categories.
eligibility: Students studying in recognised regular courses, generally from Class XI through postgraduate/professional levels. A parent must belong to a covered worker category and have at least six months of service. The applicable family-income ceiling is ₹21,000 per month or ₹2.52 lakh per year under the published guidelines. Other conditions apply, including passing the qualifying examination on the first attempt.
organization: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

title: Dr. Punjabrao Deshmukh–SARTHI Domestic Higher Education Scholarship 2026–27
amount: Full eligible tuition and specified academic fees; hostel and mess expenses for eligible institutional hostel residents; ₹10,000 per year for books and other educational expenses, subject to scheme rules.
description: Financial assistance for eligible students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate and postgraduate diploma courses at specified recognised institutions in India.
eligibility: Maharashtra residents belonging to the Maratha, Kunbi, Maratha-Kunbi or Kunbi-Maratha communities; family income up to ₹8 lakh per year; generally at least 55% in Class 12 for undergraduate admission or 55% in the undergraduate degree for postgraduate admission. Maximum age is 25 for UG and 30 for PG under the published scheme criteria. The institution must be covered by the scheme.

title: Dr. Punjabrao Deshmukh–SARTHI Domestic Higher Education Scholarship 2026–27 (UG Applicatio)
amount: Full eligible tuition and specified academic fees; hostel and mess expenses for eligible institutional hostel residents; ₹10,000 per year for books and other educational expenses, subject to scheme rules.
description: Financial assistance for eligible students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate and postgraduate diploma courses at specified recognised institutions in India.
eligibility: Maharashtra residents belonging to the Maratha, Kunbi, Maratha-Kunbi or Kunbi-Maratha communities; family income up to ₹8 lakh per year; generally at least 55% in Class 12 for undergraduate admission or 55% in the undergraduate degree for postgraduate admission. Maximum age is 25 for UG and 30 for PG under the published scheme criteria. The institution must be covered by the scheme.

title: HDFC Bank Parivartan Educational Crisis Scholarship Support (ECSS) Programme 2026–27
amount: Class 1–6: ₹15,000; Class 7–12, Diploma, ITI and Polytechnic: ₹18,000; General Undergraduate: ₹30,000; Professional Undergraduate: ₹50,000; General Postgraduate: ₹35,000; Professional Postgraduate: ₹75,000.
description: Merit-cum-need-based scholarship for students from financially weaker families who face financial difficulties or personal/family crises that may interrupt their education.
eligibility: Indian nationals studying in Classes 1–12, eligible Diploma/ITI/Polytechnic courses, or recognised undergraduate/postgraduate programmes. Minimum 55% marks in the previous qualifying examination and annual family income not exceeding ₹2.5 lakh. Preference is given to students facing personal or family crises.

title: Mahendra Scholarship Test (MST) 2026
amount: The exact scholarship amount, fee concession, and benefits have not been confirmed in the official MST information available online
description: A scholarship test conducted by Mahendra Educational Institutions. According to the official website, the MST 2026 test has concluded.
eligibility: Detailed eligibility criteria, qualifying marks, and eligible courses have not been specified on the official MST page. Students should contact the institution for confirmation.
